questions.question: Why does the authentication service hash passwords with the older Blowfish-based scheme instead of the memory-hard algorithm that won the Password Hashing Competition, and why are the work-factor rounds lowered in tests? Put the reasons and the abbreviated (7 character) hash of the commit that first recorded this decision into `answer`, and cite as `locations` the file:line where the decision record starts (its title line).
questions.note: Kind: why. Anchor line 37 is the ADR heading; sha 67e4798 is the only commit that adds the heading (git log -S '## Auth-002', feat(auth) PR1 group A).

questions.question: The device manager's registry and live drivers are mutated from the command thread while supervisor and per-device worker threads read them. What rule was adopted for how code outside the manager may read them? Put the rule and the abbreviated (7 character) hash of the commit that first recorded it into `answer`, and cite as `locations` the file:line of the line that states the decision itself.
questions.note: Kind: which decision. Anchor line 88 is the decision line of ADR-DH-008; sha e6a927f is the only commit that adds the ADR heading (git log -S '## ADR-DH-008').

questions.question: When the OTLP log exporter is configured with a receiver address that has no signal path, the schema refuses it. Which alternative treatments were considered and turned down for that case? Summarise them in `answer`, and cite as `locations` the file:line where the turned-down options are listed.
questions.note: Kind: rejected alternatives. Anchor line 358 is the Отвергнуто line of ADR-OTEL-007 (heading at line 308); no facts.

questions.question: A false WARNING appeared in the process manager's topology blueprint when two distinct NaN values were compared between a typed field and its extras. Which plan and which task brief covered the fix? Name the plan in `answer`, and cite as `locations` the first line (title) of the task brief file. Also put into `answer` the abbreviated (7 character) hash of the commit that changed the production comparison code (not the tests, not the docs).
questions.note: Kind: which plan. Task brief title is line 1 of tasks/C-79.md (plan: plans/lifecycle-stop-ownership.md); sha 4caf789 is the fix commit with trailer Refs: plans/lifecycle-stop-ownership.md (the RED tests 2226be5 and docstring 817a89c are other commits).

questions.question: The belt-look plan for the line simulator records the result of its live-stand check (what was done to the belt photo data, what matched, what was left undone). Where is that outcome written? Cite as `locations` the file:line of the heading of the outcome section.
questions.note: Kind: where is the outcome. Anchor line 91 is the Итог 1.3 heading in the plan; no facts.
